description: Starter rules. Tune thresholds with tenant history before advisory use.

rules.description: A recent SIM swap coincides with a first-seen device, a new beneficiary and a transfer above threshold.
Several outbound transfers reached multiple new beneficiaries within a short window.
At least 70% of the available balance moved in the observation window.
A young account received funds from many sources then rapidly sent funds onward.
A risk pattern occurred during overnight hours.
Beneficiary account is flagged by multiple independent network members in the fraud consortium.
Subject or beneficiary exhibits high mule likelihood in the multi-tenant entity network graph.
Rapid agent float depletion or structured smurfing detected across observation window.
